verdict.rationale: Meltano's environment concept (dev/qa/prod separated in one project) is mentioned by a community user, implying it can support sandboxed testing separate from production, but no first-party docs in this pack describe environment configuration, data isolation, or sandbox-specific tooling. missing for 10: first-party docs on Meltano Environments/config isolation, guidance on avoiding production data access, and independent hands-on confirmation of safe sandbox testing.
